Predict whether or not of the following reactions will occur spontaneously in acid solution. Determine $E^\circ_{\text{cell}}$ for the reaction that is predicted to occur : (i) Oxidation of NO to $\text{NO}_3^-$ by $\text{Sn}^{+4}$ (ii) Reduction of $\text{Mn}^{+2}$ to Mn by Zn (iii) Reduction of $\text{Br}_2$ to $\text{Br}^-$ by $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ (iv) Reduction of $\text{Br}_2$ to $\text{Br}^-$ by $\text{Fe}^{+2}$ [Data: $E^\circ_{\text{Zn/Zn}^{+2}} = 0.76 \text{ V}, E^\circ_{\text{Fe}^{+3}/\text{Fe}^{+2}} = 0.77 \text{ V}, E^\circ_{\text{NO}_3/\text{NO}} = 0.96 \text{ V}, E^\circ_{\text{Sn}^{+4}/\text{Sn}^{+2}} = 0.15 \text{ V}, E^\circ_{\text{Mn/Mn}^{+2}} = 1.18 \text{ V}, E^\circ_{\text{Br}_2/\text{Br}^-} = 1.07 \text{ V}, E^\circ_{\text{O}_2/\text{H}_2\text{O}_2} = 0.68 \text{ V}$]
